policy: Zero-Manual-Dependency-Setup: in Claude Code, `install.py install` runs `tools/deps.py ensure`, which installs every missing helper automatically — running the toolkit setup is the request. It is never hidden: every step is printed and recorded in <claude-dir>/dga-skills-install/dependencies-state.json; opt out with --no-deps or DGA_SKILLS_NO_AUTO_DEPS=1. `deps.py setup` keeps the per-helper y/N flow.
A helper the user turned off is reported as INSTALLED BUT DISABLED and is never turned on automatically.

Claude Desktop / Cowork / claude.ai: a skill cannot install or turn on other skills (platform limit). Helpers synced and turned on in the account are detected (skills/synced/<bucket>/manifest.json) and used automatically; anything else uses the local fallback without asking the user for manual steps.
Only the sources listed here are trusted. Before installing, tools/deps.py fetches the source, checks the marketplace name, the plugin entry and the licence, and refuses on any mismatch.
Nothing from these dependencies is copied into the DGA Skills Toolkit package. They install from their own marketplaces under their own licences.
Installing dga-skills never implies that these are installed. The local fallback rules work without them.
